methodology.comparison: The same current-source compiler snapshot, off versus one explicitly enabled option; other profile defaults unchanged.
methodology.compilerBuild: Private copy of installed dependencies; current Babel/integration/esbuild/Vite sources compiled with Vite/Rollup, es2020, external dependencies, ESM and CJS; no workspace dist changes.
methodology.order: Fresh Node process for each sample; switch order alternates; cases and bundlers rotate. No concurrent benchmark samples.
methodology.cold: esbuild first context rebuild, Vite production build, or Vite development client import-graph transformation; dependency imports and fixture setup excluded.
methodology.updates: Native esbuild context rebuild; Vite development awaits native watcher change listeners on all servers, including Vanilla Extract's compiler server (watchChange, module invalidation, HMR hooks), then transformRequest. No OS watcher debounce, browser network, HMR transport or rendering latency.
methodology.edits: CSS value changes, then token variable-reference changes by inserting a createVar before existing tokens; cx workload edits one feature's CSS twice.
methodology.compression: gzip level 9 and Brotli quality 11, measured after build timing; runtime module import measured separately.

workloads.ordinary: 24 consumers of ordinary .css.ts defineRules and token exports
workloads.extracted-cx: 24 feature modules using configured extractCalls with 72 module-initialization cx calls
workloads.tokens: 48 consumers, each reading 16 generated createVar exports (768 reads)
